# Nexus v1.96.3 recovery update

This maintenance release prevents large synced community caches from making the old 32-bit client crash during `/reload`.

## Fixes

- Keeps peer-posted community builds while bounding disposable automatic DPS pages.
- Stops Good-Enough-Nexus from advertising Valentine's later Nexus 1.20 patches as updates for the 1.96 compatibility line.
- Uses the current level-80 Echo loadout for Still Needed and Echoes to Shed.
- Retains exact wishlist quality matching.

Personal builds and DPS records remain protected by retention.
